how: Calls recruit maintainers and defenders for an existing flag, sign, and heart.
Members revise lettering, colours, symbols, and the allocation of space within the shared design.
Progress reports track the flag from fifteen blocks through reaching the canvas edge.

The revised element directly explains keepers restoring an obsolete design until cancellation instructions and the new plan reach them.
The now-standing attribution process distinguishes accidental script damage and stale views from alleged hostile attackers.
Members spare neighboring work and explicitly ask their own placers to preserve a neighboring character's hair.
Border questions, conditional relocations, and explicit concessions negotiate coexistence among adjacent works.
A retaliatory overtaking proposal fits the minimal attack-call range without establishing an executed collective raid.
A cleared successor canvas prompts an explicit fresh start and placement of a new first purple pixel.
The close elicits thanks, personal labor reports, and neighboring builders' accounts of what they made together.
Participants assess damage in the frozen sign and claim their shared work as Reddit history.

Going to bed limits individual availability and prompts an explicit overnight maintenance handoff.
Members encounter stale views, repeated clearings, captchas, and persistence fixes that constrain placing and require technical correction.
Mutual repairs between neighboring groups do not themselves establish dual membership or divided loyalties at a contested border.
Local instructions and corrections cannot validate a comparative prevalence claim or establish absence of decided order across the entire room.

A member carries the revised design to a neighboring subreddit and its Discord without demonstrating authority over their placers.

The original flag is already fifteen blocks long at the first coded observation, leaving its starter-to-initial-call mechanism outside the observed opening.
Growth explicitly combines with maintenance before completion redirects effort toward defense.
Border negotiation can begin during growth before maintenance mobilization, so upkeep explains renewed negotiation rather than every first border discussion.
Thanks for sparing the heart confirms restraint without establishing that a settled border agreement caused it.
Repair calls and shared scripts establish their use but do not independently show that exhausted manual capacity caused script adoption.
Reporting that the flag reached the left side also celebrates its completion, while closing posts later thank its makers.

Invitations explicitly respond to the event ending, while preservation of the old work as their causal mechanism remains unestablished.
The late report of insufficient defensive hands has no coded subsequent relocation demonstrating the proposed move mechanism.
A revised design and continuing obsolete repairs do not establish that posting a template settled agreement for all maintainers.
A request receives a maintenance promise, but the pair cannot establish the theorised expectation that every reader owes a bare acceptance or reasoned refusal.
A reply names constant attacks on the text while offering protection, and the neighboring representative directly promises maintenance help.
A space-and-defense offer opens an exchange in which background conditions are relaxed and maintenance help is promised.
No coded passage causally links the retaliatory overtaking proposal to an earlier general recruitment call.
The overtaking proposal and eventual concession occupy different reply branches without a coded refusal directly answering the attack proposal.
An overtaking proposal precedes a concession in another branch, but their ordering does not establish the proposal causing negotiation.
Retaliatory overtaking and later sign-victory talk concern different episodes and cannot establish the attack-to-contest-talk mechanism.
Defense, listed alliances, and cross-room communication coexist without establishing shared threat rather than affinity or proximity as their causal origin.

No coded reply states a limit or refusal after an agreement, leaving the revised arrow's bounded sequence unobserved.
Protective automation requires updated targets and awareness of permitted neighboring designs to avoid destroying newly intended work.
An offered repair trade can become unconditional protection while still receiving reciprocal maintenance help.
A heart keeper explicitly connects helping defend the flag with appreciation that the advancing flag spared the heart.

statement: feeling territorial without committing to conquest
how: A personal admission of territorial attachment warrants retention without demonstrating an attack, treaty, or collective property rule.

statement: gaining belonging and sustained participation through visible work
how: Shared work is described as strengthening belonging, while seeing the flag is explicitly linked to sustained placing rather than demonstrated subreddit entry.
Reflections on visibility and belonging occur during ongoing construction and maintenance as well as at completion.
Continuation after the original freeze returns to actual flag construction and reports of completed text on another canvas.
Replacement-canvas work produces overnight maintenance requests and renewed defense against sign erasure after the original hour-73 freeze.
Successor-canvas activity does not establish a collectively accepted lasting purpose when members explicitly disagree about whether the subreddit still has a use.
The invitation explicitly names the original event ending as its reason for rebuilding independently of an unproven record-to-continuation mechanism.
Reported bugs, captcha requirements, and bot resistance enter participants' stated reasons for choosing between replacement canvases.
Existing progress on a replacement flag is explicitly given as a reason to remain on that site rather than move again.
